{{Hatnote|For the A New Hope location, see [[Imperial Holotable]].}}
[[File:Holotable-game-2015.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Holotable tabletop client]]
[[File:Holotable-home-graphic.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Holotable.com homepage graphic, 2007]]

'''Holotable''' is a downloaded virtual tabletop for ''Star Wars'' CCG, with a companion deck builder called '''Holodeck'''.<ref name="c1ght">[https://blog.categoryonegames.com/holotable-playing-star-wars-ccg-online-the-setup/ Holotable - Playing Star Wars CCG Online - The Setup], Category One Games. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20220926090936/https://blog.categoryonegames.com/holotable-playing-star-wars-ccg-online-the-setup/ Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pconline">[https://web.archive.org/web/20150203045154/http://www.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/Holotable-pic-387x270.jpg Holotable-pic], starwarsccg.org (Wayback, 3 February 2015)</ref> Two players met on a shared table and enforced the rules themselves; the program moved the cards, and the people played the game. From its launch in September 2004 until [[GEMP]] took over, it was where most of the world played ''Star Wars'' CCG online, through the whole of the [[Virtual Original]] and [[Virtual Legacy]] eras.<ref name="about2009">[https://web.archive.org/web/20090415132109/http://www.holotable.com:80/about.php About The Holotable], holotable.com (Wayback, 15 April 2009)</ref><ref name="ringer">[https://www.theringer.com/2018/5/21/17374528/star-wars-customizable-card-game-player-community The Force Is Strong With This 'Star Wars' Subculture], Ben Lindbergh, ''The Ringer'', 21 May 2018. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20180523173054/https://www.theringer.com/2018/5/21/17374528/star-wars-customizable-card-game-player-community Internet Archive]</ref>

Holotable was never a [[Players Committee]] product. It was [[Matt Moseley]]'s program, and the card text inside it was typed in by a small band of volunteers who copied the PC's release PDFs and errata posts, set after set, for ten years. Their work kept the game playable online, and it later became the source of the PC's own website card list (see [[#Card data and its keepers|below]]).

== Founding ==

The about page of holotable.com says that Holotable "was created by Rogue4 and LtPage2 in September of 2004".<ref name="about2009" /><ref name="about2012">[https://web.archive.org/web/20120209233529/http://www.holotable.com/about.php About The Holotable], holotable.com (Wayback, 9 February 2012)</ref>
* '''LtPage2''', [[Matt Moseley]], a software engineer, wrote both programs: "I am the sole developer for Holotable and Holodeck."<ref name="about2012" /> The readme carries his copyright, 2004&ndash;2007 in 2007 and 2004&ndash;2011 by 2012.<ref name="readme">[https://web.archive.org/web/20071123231323/http://www.holotable.com/readme.php Holotable readme], holotable.com (Wayback, 23 November 2007). Copyright 2004&ndash;2007 Matt Moseley.</ref><ref name="readme2012">[https://web.archive.org/web/20120209233434/http://www.holotable.com/readme.php Holotable readme], holotable.com (Wayback, 9 February 2012). Copyright 2004&ndash;2011 Matt Moseley.</ref> His forum rank on the PC forums is simply "Holotable".<ref name="p667284" />
* '''Rogue4''', [[Rustan Sharer]], co-founded it: he ran the physical server and did "some basic PR work", leaving the programming "to the amazing Matt".<ref name="about2012" />

''The Ringer'' also dates the launch to late 2004.<ref name="ringer" />

== The TheForce.Net years ==

TheForce.Net hosted Holotable from January 2007.<ref name="ht2007">[https://web.archive.org/web/20070315203124/http://www.holotable.com/ holotable.com homepage], Wayback 15 March 2007</ref> On 9 April 2007 it posted twelve preconstructed decks for Classic and Saga lists.<ref name="tfn2007">[https://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/Preconstructed_Decks_Now_Available_For_Online_Star_Wars_CCG_104875.asp Pre-constructed Decks Now Available For Online Star Wars CCG], TheForce.Net, 9 April 2007. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071030072612/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/Preconstructed_Decks_Now_Available_For_Online_Star_Wars_CCG_104875.asp Internet Archive]</ref> Saga used every card. Classic used a limited list. Saga required a Starting Effect to use Defensive Shields.<ref name="tfn2007" /> Those 2007 names are distinct from the later GEMP [[Classic]] family.

Each new Virtual set reached Holotable as an update of card data files (CDFs, <code>lightside.cdf</code> and <code>darkside.cdf</code>) and card images, announced on holotable.com and signed "Matt". The news page thanks the people who supplied them: "the PC for providing the updated CDFs" (December 2005), Psychobabble (Jeremy) for the Virtual Set 12 and 13 updates (January and September 2007), [[Mark VanDriel]] for the Virtual Set 18 preview cards (July 2009), and Crickett for image updates (late 2009).<ref name="oldnews">[https://web.archive.org/web/20141019213342/http://www.holotable.com:80/oldnews.php Old News], holotable.com (Wayback, 19 October 2014): entries of 24 December 2005, 12 January 2007, 29 September 2007, 11 July 2009 and the 0.8.5 release of late 2009.</ref>

== Holotable and the Players Committee ==

The PC treated Holotable as a partner, not as one of its own departments. Its 2010 home page called Holotable "the number 1 site for online play" and sent players to www.holotable.com.<ref name="pchome2010">[https://web.archive.org/web/20100307212505/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ Star Wars CCG Players Committee home page], starwarsccg.org (Wayback, 7 March 2010)</ref> The PC listed it on its software page by 13 December 2013.<ref name="pcsoft">[https://web.archive.org/web/20131213094334/http://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/software/ Software], starwarsccg.org (Wayback, 13 December 2013)</ref> But PC news posts spoke of Holotable updates from the outside:
* 7 December 2009, Virtual Block 6.2: "As far as I know the Holotable updates have been done. They should be up today from what I've heard".<ref name="news83">[https://web.archive.org/web/20100101222734/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/news/news.php?id=83 Virtual Set 6.2 is released], post by Rogue4, starwarsccg.org (7 December 2009; Wayback, 1 January 2010)</ref>
* 10 January 2014, Virtual Block 9.1: "The cards will hopefully be in Holotable soon."<ref name="wp91">[https://web.archive.org/web/20140114065911/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/wp/v-set-9-1-is-live/ V-set 9.1 is live!], darkjediknight11 for the Advocate Team, starwarsccg.org (10 January 2014; Wayback, 14 January 2014)</ref>
* October 2014, the [[2014 Virtual Card Pool Reset|reset]]: "We expect an update to Holotable soon".<ref name="pcreset">[https://web.archive.org/web/20141009180356/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/wp/pdf-of-reset-list-posted-virtual-set-0-and-virtual-set-1-preview/ PDF of Reset List Posted], starwarsccg.org (Wayback, 9 October 2014)</ref>

Mark VanDriel, writing as AnakinSolo, put it plainly in January 2010: "holotable is owned by Matt".<ref name="p498118">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=498118#p498118 Re: V19 or 6.2 on Holotable?], post by AnakinSolo (1 January 2010), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums</ref> What counted as official card text was the PC's PDFs and its Current Rulings/Errata thread; the PC's tournament rules never name Holotable as a source of card text.<ref name="tg20">[https://web.archive.org/web/20160808081200/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Star%20Wars%20CCG%20Tournament%20Guide%202.0.pdf Star Wars CCG Tournament Guide 2.0] (2 December 2013; Wayback, 8 August 2016), § 2.1 and § 2.3: rulings and errata are in the "Current Rulings/Errata" thread; expansions are legal "as defined by the release of the PDF containing the virtual card slips".</ref>

== Card data and its keepers ==

[[File:PC forum, Holotable 7.4 thanks to Ryan Jellison, 18 December 2011.png|thumb|right|320px|"Ryan Jellison. You will thank him now." LtPage2 credits sac89837 for the Virtual Block 7.4 data, 18 December 2011.<ref name="p667284" />]]
From 2009 the card data was kept by volunteers on the PC forum. For each new set, LtPage2 (or, in 2009, AnakinSolo) asked for help; volunteers typed the new cards and errata from the PC's PDFs and posts into the CDFs, made the images, and sent the files to Matt, who posted them to the update server.<ref name="p476169">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=476169#p476169 Re: Have you found Holotable text or image errors?], post by AnakinSolo (27 October 2009), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums: looking for "HT volunteers to help with both ongoing projects and set updates".</ref><ref name="p721193">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=721193#p721193 8.1 updates for Holotable], post by LtPage2 (13 May 2012), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums: "a call for volunteers to do the 8.1 updates (CDFs and images)".</ref><ref name="p840511">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=840511#p840511 Re: Have you found Holotable text or image errors?], post by LtPage2 (4 October 2013), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums: "send me the changed file, and I can upload it."</ref> Players reported mistakes in the forum topic "Have you found Holotable text or image errors?", which kurtisblow opened on 22 July 2009 and which ran to March 2014.<ref name="p434220">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=434220#p434220 Have you found Holotable text or image errors?], post by kurtisblow (22 July 2009), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums</ref>

=== "Until the PDF's are corrected" ===

[[File:PC forum, Yoda (V) deploy thread, May–June 2010.png|thumb|right|320px|The Yoda (V) exchange in the Holotable error topic, 31 May to 26 June 2010.<ref name="p547686" /><ref name="p547713" /><ref name="p557221" /><ref name="p561177" /><ref name="p561559" />]]
The data keepers copied the PDFs; they did not overrule them, even when a PC insider asked. On 30 May 2010 Rogue4 wrote in the error topic that "our internal master list has yoda as deploy 4", so the PDFs (which said 5) were wrong for [[Yoda (V) (Virtual Block 2)|Yoda (V)]].<ref name="p547489">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=547489#p547489 Re: Have you found Holotable text or image errors?], post by Rogue4 (30 May 2010), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums</ref> kurtisblow checked: the Virtual Card Master List PDF and the Virtual Block 2 PDF both said 5. His answer: "I'll leave holotable as-is until the PDF's are corrected."<ref name="p547686">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=547686#p547686 Re: Have you found Holotable text or image errors?], post by kurtisblow, signed Kurt Schlichting (31 May 2010), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums</ref> A former World Champion backed the PDF the same morning: "The master pdf IS the official text. Not some 'internal list.'"<ref name="p547713">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=547713#p547713 Re: Have you found Holotable text or image errors?], post by arebelspy (31 May 2010), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums</ref> When the report came in again on 18 June, kurtisblow held the line: "I've decided not to update this until the master and vblock2 pdfs are updated."<ref name="p557221">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=557221#p557221 Re: Have you found Holotable text or image errors?], post by kurtisblow (18 June 2010), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums</ref> On 24 June JediJer reported "Master pdf is updated. Block 2 pdf will get updated when I get around to it."<ref name="p561177">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=561177#p561177 Re: Have you found Holotable text or image errors?], post by JediJer (24 June 2010), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums</ref> Two days later: "The Yoda (V) correction should be in Holotable now."<ref name="p561559">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=561559#p561559 Re: Have you found Holotable text or image errors?], post by kurtisblow (26 June 2010), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums</ref>

The episode shows the rule the volunteers worked by: the PC's PDFs were the official text, and Holotable followed them.

=== From Holotable to the PC website ===

[[File:PC forum, sac89837 Errata Listing, 20 July 2010.png|thumb|right|320px|sac89837 building "the Database for the Website" from SW-IP and the Holotable CDF, 20 July 2010.<ref name="p566763" />]]
The same volunteers also fed the PC's own website. On 20 July 2010 sac89837, building "the Database for the Website", wrote that he had "exhausted SW-IP and the Holotable.CDF file".<ref name="p566763">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=566763#p566763 Errata Listing], post by sac89837 (20 July 2010), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums</ref> In February and March 2013 he was still updating the website after CDF fixes.<ref name="p782160">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=782160#p782160 post by sac89837] (February 2013), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums: he would "update the website as well".</ref><ref name="p798522">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=798522#p798522 post by sac89837] (March 2013), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums: "Get the website image list updated".</ref> The PC website card lists of 2012&ndash;2013 show it: their image links are the CDF paths, and 998 of the 1,058 Virtual Legacy entries of 21 July 2012 match a surviving Holotable CDF character for character, typos included.<ref name="cardlist">PC website card list, e.g. [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html VBlock5Type] (Wayback, 21 July 2012), compared with the Holotable CDFs of [https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/darkside.cdf 29 May 2010], [https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/d14e714/db/darkside.cdf 1 August 2010] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20190907044537/http://www.holotable.com/download/downloads/holotable-0.9.9_install_linux.tar.bz2 5 October 2014]. Comparison: [https://github.com/billbisco/ai-team-skills/blob/main/shared/gemp-legacy-cards/versions/sources/R7-HOLOTABLE-GOVERNANCE.md R7 research notes], § 4.</ref>

So the volunteers' transcriptions, which the PC had never treated as official, ended up published on the PC's own site, and many Virtual Legacy cards gained an extra version that way. The data took errata weeks to years after the PC posted them, sometimes never, and sometimes in its own words; the story is told card by card in [[PC Legacy Virtual Transcription Error History]].

== Later years and GEMP ==

Version 0.9.9, announced 2 December 2014 and signed Matt, handled the [[2014 Virtual Card Pool Reset|virtual card reset]].<ref name="ht2014">[https://web.archive.org/web/20141217162132/http://www.holotable.com/ holotable.com homepage], Wayback 17 December 2014. News dated 12/2/14.</ref> Championship lists from the [[2014 Match Play Championship]] were published as Holotable exports. The card data later moved to the PC's own GitHub repository ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable swccgpc/holotable], from July 2018), and the PC organization chart now has a "Holotable CDF Maintainer", Ron Howe.<ref name="orgchart">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf PC organization chart] (PDF, created 6 May 2024), res.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261010210152/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

[[GEMP]] later provided server-adjudicated play, with the game engine enforcing the rules that Holotable players had enforced themselves. [[Troy Biesterfeld]] created the Star Wars CCG implementation of GEMP.
